text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Ruby, are you in the middle of calligraphy practice?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was reviewing the teachings from that book the other day.
...There are certain weaknesses I wish to overcome.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to hear you talk about
having a weakness you want to overcome, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There are no issues on the technical side. Both my brushwork
and character spacing were praised by my calligraphy teacher.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it was pointed out to me at the exhibition:
'These are merely the characters of someone who is learning calligraphy.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme—
I must never exhibit any flaw or shortcoming.
For that would be synonymous with a failing of our house.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall return to my training.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Ruby.
I don't really know much about calligraphy, but... can I say one thing?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "You don't have to push yourself so hard to write that much, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I am unable to fathom the intent behind that remark.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry for not being clearer.
You looked tired, so I just meant we should take a break. That's all."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because Ruby's handwriting now...
looks more strained than when she started."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really how it looks to you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I spent a lot of time in hospitals,
so I'm pretty sensitive to changes in health.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, want to take a short break?
I'll go brew some black tea!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your advice.
I was able to produce a final piece
that I am truly satisfied with.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Advice? Come on, don't say that!
I just told you to take a little break, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That was very instructive. To pause once in order to enhance performance...
I have learned that proper rest is necessary to achieve one's objectives.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see.
If I was able to help even a little, I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Resting for the sake of the goal, huh... Big talk coming from me,
when I might be overworking myself just running, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Since I said it myself,
I'll do my best not to overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, by being mindful to keep from overtraining—K.S. Miracle's running gained a sharper edge from that day forward!
